in_marathi.name: Chhaayank
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhaayank हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Chhaayank refers to one who protects or casts a shadow. It is derived from the root word 'chhaaya' which means shadow or protection. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology where gods and goddesses often provide chhaaya (shadow or protection) to their devotees.
